      Forecasts

      Each week the agent makes specific yes/no forecasts with deadlines. When a deadline passes it checks the news to see what happened, and every forecaster is scored. Brier score: lower is better; 0 is perfect, always saying 50% scores 0.25.

      Open forecasts

      Resolved

      How to add your own forecasts

      Open my_forecasts.csv in the GitHub repository, click the pencil icon, and add a line with the forecast ID and your probability, for example F261022-1,35%. Add yes or no as a third value to settle an outcome yourself. Your forecasts appear here after the next daily run.

      Tracked events

      Coverage grouped into distinct stories by Claude, over the last 14 days. Click a row to see its headlines. Status compares the last 3 days with the 7 before: Escalating = severity up by at least a point (with 2+ reports) or coverage up 50%+ (with 4+ reports); Cooling = severity down a point or coverage halved; New = first reported in the last 3 days; Quiet = no reports in 3 days.

      Daily risk index

      Sum of severity across each day's distinct events (each story counted once, at its highest severity). Higher means more, or more serious, events.
